entities.summary: Juan Armada y Losada (May 4, 1861, in Madrid – September 22, 1932, in Abegondo) was a Spanish politician. He was the 29th Solicitor General of Spain, acting President of the Congress of Deputies, Minister of Development and Minister of Justice. He was a novelist and a poet both in Spanish and Galician.
